content: date-fns v4 added first-class timezone support via @date-fns/tz and has a pt-BR locale; it is 13KB vs Luxon's 23KB. Temporal API shipped natively in Chrome 144 (Jan 2026) but is not yet supported in all major browsers, so native Temporal is too early for production cross-browser use in 2026. rrule.js implements RFC-5545 recurrence (RRULE strings) and is the standard choice for recurring tasks/bills; rrule-temporal is a newer Temporal-based rewrite for teams ready to commit to Temporal.
